list.label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
list.source: Anthropic's models overview (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview, read 2026-09-30): Claude API ID claude-sonnet-5-5, adaptive thinking, default effort high, 1M context, 128K output. Price (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing): $2 input, $10 output, $0.20 cache hits, $2.50 and $4 cache writes (5 minutes, 1 hour). Effort low to max (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/effort); thinking type between_tools turns up-front thinking off at effort high or below, and disabled is refused (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking-troubleshooting).

list.label: Claude Opus 5.5
list.source: Anthropic's models overview (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview, read 2026-09-30): claude-opus-5-5, adaptive thinking always on (disabled is refused), default effort medium, 1M context, 128K output (read 2026-10-02). Price (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing): $4 input, $20 output, $0.20 cache hits (0.05x), $5 and $8 cache writes. Effort low to max (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/effort).

list.label: Claude Fable 5.1
list.source: Anthropic's models overview (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview, read 2026-09-30): claude-fable-5-1, adaptive thinking always on (disabled is refused), default effort high, 1M context, 128K output (read 2026-10-02); one of the Covered Models kept at least 30 days. Price (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing): $10 input, $50 output, $0.25 cache hits (0.025x), $12.50 and $20 cache writes. Effort low to max (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/effort).

list.label: Claude Sonnet 5
list.source: A legacy model, still available (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview, read 2026-09-30; 128K output, https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/sonnet-5/overview, read 2026-10-02): adaptive thinking on by default, thinking type disabled accepted (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking-troubleshooting), effort low to max. Price (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing): $2 input, $10 output, now the standard price (the step to $3 and $15 on 2026-09-01 didn't happen).

list.label: Claude Haiku 4.5
list.source: Anthropic's models overview (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview, read 2026-09-30): alias claude-haiku-4-5 (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001), extended thinking only (thinking type enabled with budget_tokens of at least 1,024, below max_tokens), off by default, no effort parameter, 200K context, 64K output. Price (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing): $1 input, $5 output, $0.10 cache hits. Retirement (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/model-deprecations, read 2026-10-02): active, tentative retirement date not sooner than October 15, 2026 (retiresAfter); no cheaper Claude replaces it, so the window offers the default, Claude Sonnet 5.5 (moveTo).

errorMap.notes: Low credit arrives as 402 billing_error in the docs and as a 400 with 'credit balance is too low' in the field; both are handled. A tier spend cap is a 429 whose error.details.error_code is enforced_spend_limit_reached, with no retry-after; it fails until 00:00 UTC on the 1st. A 403 permission_error is a permission or workspace problem with a good key (no access to that model), never a rejected key: only the 401 is (§10).

privacy.retention: Deleted within 30 days by default; at least 30 days on the Covered Models (Fable 5/5.1, Mythos 5/5.1); flagged content up to 2 years
privacy.zdr: By arrangement with sales, per organization
privacy.notes: Keys are Console API keys. There's no balance endpoint for normal keys.

player.short: Deletes messages within 30 days by default; no training without your feedback.
player.keeps: Deleted within 30 days by default; longer on some newer models. Flagged content is kept up to 2 years.
player.trains: No, unless you send Anthropic feedback.
player.zeroRetention: By arrangement with Anthropic’s sales team.

terms.login: API key only (DB6). Third-party apps may not offer Claude.ai login or route Free, Pro or Max credentials.
notes: A Claude Pro or Max subscription isn't an API key and doesn't include API credit.
Unscoped personal keys need the anthropic-workspace-id header.
Never send temperature, top_p or top_k: Sonnet 5 and 4.7+ models reject them.
playerNotes: A Claude Pro or Max subscription isn’t an API key and doesn’t include API credit.
